notes.road.title: The driving game's title, over the radio.
notes.road.radio: Before the drive: pick the song the car's radio plays.
notes.road.radio.keys: LEFT / RIGHT: the arrow keys that change the song; {key:confirm} the key or button that starts the drive.
notes.road.radio.touch: On a phone: tap a song to pick it, tap it again to start the drive.
notes.road.song.breeze: A song's title on the radio: translate or keep, as song titles go in your language.
notes.road.song.sunset: A song's title on the radio.
notes.road.song.neon: A song's title on the radio.
notes.road.area.beach: A stretch of the road, named in big letters as you reach it.
notes.road.area.tunnel: A stretch of the road that runs through a tunnel in the cliffs.
notes.road.banner.check: You passed a checkpoint and the clock got more time (the arcade's call); {area} is the next stretch's name.
notes.road.arch.checkpoint: Written across an arch over the road.
notes.road.arch.goal: Written across the arch at the finish.
notes.road.gear.low: The gear the car is in: low gear (a touch button and the HUD).
notes.road.gear.high: The gear the car is in: high gear (a touch button and the HUD).
notes.road.goal: You reached the finish in time.
notes.road.end: At the end: {score} the score (digits), {distance} how far you got, in percent of the road. Three spaces between the two.
notes.road.again: After a key or button's name: press it to drive again.
notes.action.gas: Accelerate: an action's name on the controls screen.
notes.action.brake: An action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.
notes.action.gear: Change gear (low, high): an action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.

brief: The road: an arcade driving game in the spirit of OutRun. A convertible drives a coast road through five areas against a countdown clock; each checkpoint gives time back (EXTENDED PLAY! is the arcade call for it), and the goal must be reached before it runs out. First the player picks a song on the car's radio; the songs have titles. Short words, mostly in capitals.
